story.summary: Andoni Iraola’s team have shot up the table after a slow start but they are still not scoring enough goalsBy WhoScoredEvery Liverpool win this season seems to come with an asterisk. Yes, they beat Brentford, but Brentford had a man sent off. Yes they beat Villarreal, but they conceded three. On Sunday, against Brighton the asterisks finally ran out. Liverpool beat the Premier League’s top scorers
